_doc: Fixed hyperparameters of the 2024 parametric ParticleNet (docs/PLAN_ParticleNet.md P7, P8, P10, P11): the previous best model at MHc130_MA90 (AN-25-154 tab:BestModel: 256 nodes, Adam, initLR 1e-4, weight decay 3e-5, ReduceLROnPlateau; dropout 0.4, lambda 0.1) with the ParticleNetMD architecture (GraphNorm, 3 dynamic EdgeConv k = 4 with residual shortcut, BN and dropout, edge dropout = dropout as the previous default, mean pooling, 2 dense layers) and its training settings (batch 512, <= 120 epochs, patience 10 on the early-stopping loss, ReduceLROnPlateau factor 0.5 patience 5 stepped on the training loss, phi rotation augmentation). Read by python/train.py.
